verdict.rationale: Poke's docs say Recipes let users 'easily set up automations and integrations' [poke-docs-28], and external services like GitHub, CI/CD or monitoring tools can trigger Poke via the API [poke-docs-2, poke-docs-1]. The product also describes itself as a 'proactive' assistant with reminders [poke-probe-1, poke-docs-25], which points to background, event-driven behavior. But the evidence never documents scheduled or recurring jobs, or how automations run unattended, so autonomy is mostly implied. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring background tasks, details of autonomous execution and monitoring of automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
